subject: Chevalier Theatre Balcony Lighting and Funding
overview: The committee met to review the facility needs of the Chevalier Theatre and the status of its state earmark funding. The committee approved a motion to request administration assistance in applying for Community Preservation Act funds or identifying free cash for critical balcony lighting upgrades.

items.title: Resolution on the State of the Chevalier Theatre
items.summary: The committee discussed state funding, facility repairs, and safety concerns with Cindy Watson of the Friends of the Chevalier and Facilities Director Paul Righi. The committee approved a motion requesting that the city administration assist in seeking Community Preservation Act funding or identifying free cash to address immediate balcony lighting needs.
